problem: Independent frozen v3 code-organization finding: proposal lacks concrete rollback and duplicate disposition. Preserve its original failure and prepare a separately registered feedback-assisted repair.
mechanism: Actual published local Mailbox conveys immutable independent finding to genuine model repair worker; artifact reference goes to independent reviewer for original-finding revalidation.
counterfactual: An ACK alone leaves original finding open; v3 failed output remains immutable.
acceptance: Separate protected repair run, same candidate/task/input/rubric and explicit feedback, max_attempts=1
Genuine worker reads inbox and version/hash-checked original finding before repair
Independent context consumes actual repair and checks all original criteria, closes stable finding only on evidence
Stale-version rejection/idempotence/restart observed separately from model task results
Original frozen failures and unchanged-input hashes preserved; no unrelated source changes
minimum_meaningful_improvement: One originally failed finding correctly closed by artifact-grounded independent recheck, with all original case criteria passing. This is task recovery only, not general model performance.
unacceptable_regression: ACK counted as scientific or task success

budget.scope: One existing failed code-organization case; synchronous authorized host adapter, no paid runtime or new persistent service

stop: If repair fails or capacity unavailable, preserve checkpoint; no publication gate relaxation.
trigger_relation: Same currently live batch owner observed; latest trigger continued rather than duplicated.
pre_dispatch_correction: Controller initially reported v3 max_attempts=1; direct adapter inspection found max_attempts=2 while worker instructions allowed one attempt. No second v3 attempt started. Selected separate repair max_attempts=1 remains unchanged; no silent original-run mutation.
